docs.title: Analytics Engineer, Medispend
docs.text:
Florida, USA (Remote from India)

June 2022 – present

  • Designed and maintained dbt pipelines with incremental models, data quality tests, and semantic layers to transform raw healthcare data into reliable, analytics-ready datasets.

  • Built and optimized dimensional data models and semantic layers for Power BI reporting, enabling self-service dashboards across multiple business units.

  • Engineered efficient SQL queries and robust data models to support high-volume datasets and enterprise-scale reporting.

  • Utilized Python to build data validation and workflow automation scripts, supporting ETL processes and improving data pipeline reliability.

  • Defined and codified key business metrics in collaboration with cross-functional teams, translating requirements into data models that delivered actionable insights for strategic decision-making.

  • Established a centralized metrics catalog and data documentation framework, standardizing business definitions across departments and reducing metric discrepancies in cross-team reporting.

  • Implemented automated data quality monitoring with threshold-based alerting across pipeline stages, proactively identifying and resolving data anomalies before they impacted downstream analytics.
